stable.notes: Jedi Nia Solari, Jedi Elara Vale and Jedi Rowan Vale now fight. Each carries authored four-frame animation for the two, three and four-plus session states: guard, the droids fire, the blade lands on one of them, and that droid is knocked back with a cut scar and its blaster down while the rest stay upright. How many droids you see tells you how many sessions are running, one then three then five. Their other seven states keep the single portrait. If you already picked one of the three, the new animation lands on its own the next time you open Control. Fixes: a sprite pack or a single image that failed to install no longer takes your current character with it; a dropped session row stays dropped instead of returning on the next refresh, and the list now offers to show dropped rows again; older packs draw correctly at every session count; and a short animation no longer plays faster than it was drawn for. Pairs with server 6.41.0.

notice.title: One last Accessibility toggle
notice.body: This update changes how COS Control is signed so macOS keeps your Accessibility permission across future updates. macOS drops the old grant one final time: open System Settings, Privacy & Security, Accessibility, toggle COS Control off and on, then reopen COS Control. You will not need to do this again.
